name: Anastasia Kioutsoukis
title: Psychologist
description: A warm and curious psychologist who really values genuine connection. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+, childhood trauma/PTSD and sexual trauma/PTSD.

name: Ben Fletcher
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Throughout my career, I've worked with anxiety, depression, complex trauma, PTSD, grief and loss, gender dysphoria, chronic pain, and adult ADHD. I of course welcome neurodivergent and LGBTQIA+ clients. Board Approved Supervisor.
specialties: complex trauma, PTSD, gender dysphoria, LGBTQIA+, chronic pain, ADHD

name: Aliese Andrevska
title: Psychologist
description: I work with adults navigating anxiety, stress, depression, relationship concerns, identity, and life transitions. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+ and sexual trauma/PTSD.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, gender/sexual identity, sexual trauma, anxiety, relationships

name: Miriam von Furstenberg
title: Psychologist
description: Supports a broad range of concerns including OCD, phobias, anxiety, sleep difficulties and life transitions. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+.

name: Katherine Jones
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I support people experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, PTSD, sleep difficulties, low self-esteem, and stress. I draw on evidence-based approaches such as CBT, ACT, trauma-focused CBT, mindfulness, schema-informed therapy, and CBT for Insomnia.
specialties: trauma, PTSD, schema-informed therapy, insomnia, psycho-oncology

name: Dr Dom Fernandez
title: Psychologist & Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: A Psychologist with experience across university, private practice, and community mental health settings supporting adolescents and adults. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+.

name: Dr Marc Janover
title: Psychologist
description: I work with a wide range of issues and concerns, including depression, anxiety, stress, self-esteem, grief and loss, relationship issues, existential concerns and sense of identity — particularly around sexual identity and LGBTI-related matters.
specialties: LGBTI, sexual identity, sport psychology, existential concerns

name: Rozalia Hecht
title: Psychologist (Educational and Developmental endorsement)
description: I work with a range of neurodevelopmental, mental health, social, and emotional presentations in a neuro-affirming, and sexuality- and gender-affirming way. Focus areas include Gender/Sexual Identity/LGBTQIA+ and childhood trauma/PTSD.

name: Charlotte Wardell
title: Psychologist
description: A trauma-informed psychologist. I find it especially rewarding working with those exploring their identity and sense of self, healing from complex trauma. I've also had the privilege of supporting people from the LGBTIQ+ and culturally diverse communities. I draw on ACT, CBT, DBT, Schema Therapy, and psychodynamic approaches.
specialties: complex trauma, LGBTIQ+, schema therapy, identity, DBT
